PREVIEW — playwright-xtras is experimental, built for teaching & workshops.
Not for production use. https://github.com/AgentiaPT/playwright-dotnet-xtras

playwright-xtras-cli — a .NET equivalent of the Playwright Agent CLI

USAGE
  playwright-xtras-cli [-s=<session>] <command> [operands...] [flags]

GLOBAL FLAGS
  -s, --session=<name>   target a named session (or set PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION)
  --headed               launch a visible browser (session creation only)
  --browser=<name>       chromium | firefox | webkit | chrome | edge
  --persistent           use a persistent profile
  --raw                  print only the command result (no page footer)
  --allow-unrestricted-file-access
                         lift the default sandbox: permit file:// navigation and file I/O
                         (upload/screenshot/snapshot/pdf) outside the working directory.
                         Default: file:// is blocked and file I/O is confined to the cwd.
                         (session creation only; or set PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_ALLOW_UNRESTRICTED_FILE_ACCESS=1)
  --allowed-origins=<list>
                         ;-separated glob allowlist of network origins the browser may request
                         (default: all). Session creation only; or PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
  --blocked-origins=<list>
                         ;-separated glob blocklist (evaluated before the allowlist).
                         Session creation only; or PLAYWRIGHT_XTRAS_BLOCKED_ORIGINS.

NAVIGATION   open [url] | goto <url> | go-back | go-forward | reload | close
INTERACTION  click <ref> [button] | dblclick <ref> | fill <ref> <text> [--submit]
             type <text> | select <ref> <value> | check/uncheck <ref> | hover <ref>
             drag <fromRef> <toRef> | upload [ref] <file>
CAPTURE      snapshot [ref|css] [--filename=f] [--depth=n] | screenshot [ref] [--full-page]
             [--filename=f] | pdf [--filename=f]
INPUT        press <key> | keydown/keyup <key> | mousemove <x> <y> | mousedown/mouseup [button]
             mouse
